item.title: Residents fight California AI data centre; judge demands environmental review
item.description: A judge in California has ordered an extensive environmental review for an AI data center proposed in Imperial County. Concerns among local residents center on water resource impacts, emissions, and community disturbances. Developer Sebastian Rucci claims the project will generate jobs and tax income while enhancing AI infrastructure. However, legal disputes persist from the City of Imperial and environmental advocates challenging its progression.

item.title: Sold house, bought Rs 1.10 cr flat with wife; I-T dept rejects exemption for half amount
item.description: A man sold his residential property and invested the proceeds in another flat in Mumbai. The replacement property was jointly registered in his and his wife's names, with the total investment of around Rs 1.10 crore. He claimed exemption on the capital gains under Section 54 of the Income Tax Act.

item.title: Site of Texas' oldest racetrack could become 1m-sq-ft industrial building
item.description: A historic horse racing venue in Texas is poised for transformation into a massive industrial site by Dalfen Industrial, raising concerns regarding the local community's identity and heritage. The developers have proposed a million-square-foot facility but have also committed to donating land for a park and amphitheatre to celebrate the venue's legacy.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Oregon woman working 3 jobs gets free $16,000 heating system after breakdown
item.description: Diane and Brian Johnsen, a retired couple in Beaverton, Oregon, faced financial difficulties in maintaining their home. After their heating and cooling system failed, they sought assistance from the Lennox Feel the Love programme. This initiative provides essential home improvements to qualifying homeowners at no cost. Local contractor Aviator Heating & Cooling installed a new HVAC system valued at $16,000 for the couple.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Steve Ballmer gave $10mn to restore LA courts; 350 projects completed 4 years later
item.description: Steve Ballmer and his wife, Connie Ballmer, donated $10 million to renovate basketball courts in Los Angeles. The project successfully revamped 350 courts throughout the city, making them more accessible. The Clippers Community Courts project was completed on June 28, 2022, at the Michelle and Barack Obama Sports Center. The renovated courts have served multi-purpose functions during the Covid-19 pandemic, aiding the community.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Emilia Clarke's charity helps over 1,200 brain injury survivors in 7 years
item.description: In 2019, Emilia Clarke established SameYou, a charity dedicated to enhancing rehabilitation options for brain injury survivors. With over £3.8 million raised, the initiative has positively impacted more than 1,200 lives. One of its key offerings, NeuroRehabilitation Online, utilizes teletherapy to connect patients with qualified therapists. By focusing on the crucial recovery phase post-hospital, SameYou strives to fill significant gaps in patient care, garnering accolades for its innovative support approaches.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: 6 ops in 48 hrs: Houthis claim to strike Saudi airports, oil field & military sites
item.description: Yemen's Iran-linked Houthi rebels announced six military operations targeting Saudi Arabia over the last 48 hours. They claimed to have struck strategic sites including oil facilities and airports, causing significant damage and disruption. This escalation followed reported Saudi airstrikes on Yemeni civilian areas, resulting in numerous casualties. Houthi spokesperson Yahya Saree highlighted the Houthis' use of ballistic missiles and drones in these operations.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: Tiger Shroff shooting: The Salman connection & a trail of threats linked to Bishnoi
item.description: The firing at Tiger Shroff’s car in Mumbai has brought the Lawrence Bishnoi gang’s alleged threats against Bollywood personalities back into focus. A purported claim of responsibility linked the attack to Shroff’s association with Salman Khan. The incident has revived scrutiny of past threats against Khan, shootings involving his associates and the gang’s alleged network across borders, while police verify the claims.
item.dc:creator: ABHISHEK MISHRA

item.title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35M mansion faces another property review
item.description: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion faces fresh scrutiny as local officials continue reviewing plans for the historic lakeside estate. While the revised six-foot privacy fence received approval in September, the proposed rear landscaping remains unresolved. Neighbors have raised concerns about tree heights and potential damage to shared sewer lines. Bratenahl’s Architectural Review Board is scheduled to revisit the landscaping proposal on November 10, 2026, leaving parts of the property improvements pending.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf lose $3M on $23M Tiburon mansion
item.description: In 2006, tennis legends Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf agreed to sell their luxurious Tiburon estate for $20 million, taking a reported $3 million loss. The 3.5-acre property featured a sprawling mansion, two swimming pools, a tennis court and stunning Golden Gate Bridge views. After nearly four years on the market, the couple reduced the asking price several times. High maintenance costs and the home's dated interiors reportedly made selling difficult.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Bigg Boss 20: Rohit Shetty to host Weekend Ka Vaar in Salman Khan's absence
item.description: Salman Khan has announced that he will skip hosting the upcoming Weekend Ka Vaar episode of Bigg Boss 20 due to prior engagements. Rohit Shetty will step in to host, a familiar role as he’s taken over from Salman in previous seasons. Fans on social media have been buzzing with reactions about Shetty's reappearance. The latest episode included an emotional elimination of Aman Gandhi, affecting several contestants deeply.

item.title: Over 45% of Saudi flights cancelled since Oct 8, residents scramble for alternatives
item.description: Saudi Arabia is facing major travel disruptions following a large number of flight cancellations since October 8. Due to attacks by Houthi rebels, Riyadh's airport remains closed and travelers seek alternative routes. Businesses and expatriates are navigating challenges associated with remote working and adjusted travel plans. Major events in the country have been postponed or canceled, impacting international investments.
item.dc:creator: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: Daler Mehndi asked to stop singing at Navratri event in Tehri
item.description: During the Kunjapuri Fair in Uttarakhand, singer Daler Mehndi sparked controversy when Minister Subodh Uniyal accused him of performing under alcohol's influence. Highlighting the religious importance of Navratri, Uniyal stressed the need for decorum. In response, Mehndi asked the minister to step off the stage, igniting discussions about the appropriateness of entertainment at such sacred occasions.

item.title: France unrest: PM orders curfews, hints at declaring emergency; over 2,400 arrested
item.description: France has experienced significant unrest following protests over rising living costs and public services, resulting in violence and property damage. More than 2,400 people were arrested nationwide as rioters targeted shops, city halls, and public offices. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu instructed local authorities to consider curfews to prevent further violence while reviewing policing policies.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: India shelves coal import plan as high global prices, weak rupee raise costs
item.description: India has decided not to mandate coal imports for power plants due to high international prices and a weaker rupee. Coal stockpiles have reached critically low levels at many power stations, prompting concerns about electricity shortages in the country. Policymakers are focusing on boosting domestic coal production and improving transportation to mitigate the situation.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: 'O Captain, My Captain': Should Congress make room for Amarinder Singh again?
item.description: As the 2027 assembly elections approach, the Punjab Congress is strategically recalibrating its leadership. Pargat Singh steps into the role of party president, supported by Raja Warring and Charanjit Singh Channi in the campaign efforts. Meanwhile, Sachin Pilot hints at Captain Amarinder Singh's unpredictable political future amid his recent critiques of the BJP's policies on Punjab.
item.dc:creator: PALLAVI

item.title: Manipur CM condemns killing of civilians, orders tighter security in vulnerable areas
item.description: Manipur's chief minister Y Khemchand Singh condemned the killing of three civilians by suspected militants on Monday. Protesters placed the bodies outside the chief minister's residence, prompting police to intervene. Security forces launched a combing operation to apprehend the assailants, employing sniffer dogs and helicopters for assistance. Violence also erupted a day prior in Thoubal, leaving one person dead during community clashes.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Watch: Calm couple, unfazed jogger defy chaos on streets of France
item.description: France is currently facing significant protests driven by rising living costs and deteriorating public services. While some residents appear unfazed by the chaos, many cities have witnessed violent rioting and looting. The government has implemented tighter security measures after over 2,400 individuals were arrested during recent unrest. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu has suggested localised curfews to curb further violence.

item.title: Odisha vs Andhra over Kotia: Naveen Patnaik turns up heat on Mohan Majhi govt
item.description: BJD chief Naveen Patnaik has written to chief minister Mohan Charan Majhi, questioning the state government’s silence after Andhra Pradesh announced panchayat polls that may cover disputed Kotia villages. He asked whether the “Go Back Andhra” slogan was an election gimmick, as Congress and BJP leaders also weigh in.
item.dc:creator: KANISHK SHARMA

item.title: India probes Pernod Ricard, Diageo over Scotch whisky imports under UK trade pact
item.description: Indian tax authorities are examining whether Pernod Ricard and Diageo wrongly classified bulk Scotch whisky imports for lower tariffs. The investigation follows reduced import duties under the recent India-UK trade pact that came into effect on July 15. Tax inspectors visited Pernod Ricard’s headquarters and searched Diageo’s offices regarding these classifications. Both companies claim they are cooperating fully with the authorities during the investigation.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Bob Barker spent nearly $1m to move 3 elephants to sanctuary in 2013
item.description: In a major win for animal welfare, three elderly elephants—Iringa, Toka, and Thika—have journeyed from Toronto Zoo to a sanctuary thanks to Bob Barker's generous funding of nearly $1 million. Their four-day trek concluded at the Performing Animal Welfare Society in California, where they will need time and veterinary expertise to adjust after decades of captivity. This move symbolizes hope for the future of the elephants and advocates alike.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: French unrest hits football: Marseille & Lille stores looted as clubs condemn violence
item.description: The weekend unrest in France led to severe vandalism and looting at Olympique de Marseille and Lille. Marseille's official store on La Canebière was damaged and will remain closed for repairs, while Lille's downtown store also suffered extensive vandalism and is closed until further notice. Both clubs have condemned these acts, expressing solidarity with their employees and supporters as authorities launch cleanup operations and impose restrictions.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Over 50 killed as Houthis target Yemen military camp with ballistic missiles
item.description: A deadly Houthi missile attack on a military training camp in Shabwa province killed at least 50 coalition fighters. The attack also resulted in over two dozen troops wounded, according to military officials. Following the strikes, Yemeni forces reported recapturing territory in Taiz governorate, while Houthi forces continued their offensive. In another incident, a coalition airstrike killed nine people, including children and women, in Saada.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY
